**Quasicrystalline Spin Foam with Matter: Definitions and Examples** is published in [*Academia Quantum* 2(1), March 21, 2025](https://www.academia.edu/3064-979X/2/1/10.20935/AcadQuant7585), by Marcelo Maciel Amaral, Richard Clawson, and Klee Irwin. The [2023 arXiv preprint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.01964) remains available.

## Scientific Question & Motivation

In background-independent approaches to quantum gravity, histories of quantum geometry are summed over discrete 2-complexes (spin foams). Two foundational questions arise:

1. **Combinatorial Selection & Matter Coupling:** What geometric principle restricts the sum over arbitrary 2-complexes so that long-range quasi-translational order and realistic gauge/fermionic matter couplings emerge?
2. **Relational Time Evolution:** In a diffeomorphism- and reparametrization-invariant theory without external coordinate time, how are quantum transition amplitudes evaluated with respect to physical internal clocks?

## Conceptual & Mathematical Overview

### 1. Cut-and-Project 2-Complexes and $\mathrm{SU}(2)_q$ State Sums
By projecting root lattices (such as $D_n$, $E_8$, or icosahedral lattices) onto lower-dimensional physical slices via cut-and-project model sets [@amaral2021modelsets; @amaral2021statesum], the resulting cellular decomposition possesses deterministic aperiodic order, discrete scale-inflation symmetry, and finite local vertex configurations. Decorating edges and faces with representations of $\mathcal{U}_q(\mathfrak{su}(2))$ at the fifth root of unity $q = e^{2\pi i / 5}$ regulates bubble divergences and connects 3D/4D spin-foam amplitudes directly to golden-ratio quantum dimensions [@amaral2022fifthroot]. Extending this cellular complex with gauge holonomies and vertex matter fields yields explicit quasicrystalline spin-foam models with matter [@amaral2023qsf].

### 2. Path-Integral Relational Clocks
In constrained Hamiltonian systems $C(q^a, p_a) = 0$, choosing a local degree of freedom $t = q^0$ as an internal clock requires gauge-fixing Fadeev–Popov determinants that remain valid even near turning points where a single clock stops being monotonic, enabling consistent clock-switching inside the path integral [@amaral2018time].
